preprocessing: The retained 3712 by 3712 Meteosat native cloud mask and its historical latitude/longitude arrays are preserved in original pixel order. The locally recovered original EPIC L2 cloud mask is mapped with policy A and sampled by nearest neighbour at the retained native navigation using the Stage 09G 0.15 degree distance limit. The valid mask is EPIC/Meteosat availability intersected with its 180-degree counterpart, matching the Stage 09G common-valid candidate-comparison principle. No clean array was transformed to inject a fault and no intermediate display grid was created.
known_missing_evidence: This package reconstructs the direct native-grid diagnostic from the recovered EPIC L2 file rather than replaying the historical 0.05-degree EPIC-view output. The deterministic effect is independently checked against the retained Stage 09G full-resolution metrics.
